LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: SIMPLE SENTENCES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you determine what to include in a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: are improved as learners speak and sign clearly and effectively by making points in a logical order.

Values:
Respect: is enhanced as learners write a short dialogue using simple sentences and share it with peers online and offline.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate the skill of constructing simple sentences to their learning in Kiswahili or Kenya Sign Language

Word cards, Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g. tablets and mobile phones, Dictionary, Internet,
